name: md-graph-studio
description: Edit semantic Markdown graphs entirely inside VS Code.

markdownGraphStudio.storageMode.description: Storage strategy for canvas layout metadata. 'sidecar' stores layout in .md.graph.json, keeping Markdown completely clean.

markdownGraphStudio.sidecarNaming.description: Naming convention for sidecar files: 'foo.md.graph.json' or 'foo.graph.json'.

languageModelTools.name: markdownGraphStudio_create_markdownGraph
languageModelTools.userDescription: Create a Markdown Graph Studio diagram in the current workspace.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create or replace a Markdown Graph Studio .md diagram from structured nodes and edges, then open it in the graph editor. Use this when the user asks to create a diagram, graph, mind map, architecture map, dependency map, or flowchart. The tool writes the file itself; do not generate Markdown separately. Use stable kebab-case node IDs. Shapes are rounded-rectangle or rectangle. Colors are gray, blue, green, yellow, red, or purple.

filePath.description: Workspace-relative or absolute .md file path inside the current workspace.

commands.title: Markdown Graph Studio: Open as Graph
Markdown Graph Studio: Open Text and Graph Side by Side
Markdown Graph Studio: Convert to Sidecar Storage
Markdown Graph Studio: Embed Metadata into Markdown

scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run build
scripts.package: npm run verify && vsce package --allow-missing-repository --out dist/markdown-graph-studio.vsix
